2609.01601.title: Adaptive Critical Token-Aware Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
2609.01601.paper_summary: The repository-level code generation task requires synthesizing code that satisfies task requirements while remaining consistent with the target repository context. Since real-world repositories often exceed the input length limits of LLMs, existing approaches commonly adopt retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide repository-specific context. Despite improving repository-context retrieval, existing methods typically provide context as task-level support, without explicitly identifying the critical tokens that require fine-grained repository context during generation. During the autoregressive generation process of LLMs, errors often concentrate at a small number of decisive positions: once such tokens are generated incorrectly, subsequent code may follow an incorrect semantic path and eventually lead to functional failure. We refer to these positions as "critical tokens". In this paper, we propose ACToR, an adaptive critical token-aware retrieval framework for repository-level code generation. ACToR identifies critical tokens during generation and triggers targeted retrieval on demand to provide repository context at these decisive positions. In addition, we design a position-aware weighting method for dense retrievers to prioritize context that is more informative for generation. We evaluate ACToR on two representative repository-level benchmarks, RepoExec and CoderEval. Experimental results show that ACToR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving relative improvements of 8.4% on RepoExec and 15.4% on CoderEval. Beyond performance gains, we systematically quantify the impact of critical tokens, revealing their central role in major generation failures and highlighting the necessity of targeted retrieval strategies. We provide the code and data at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR.
2609.01601.paper_summary_zh: 該倉庫級別的代碼生成任務需要合成滿足任務要求的代碼，同時保持與目標倉庫上下文的一致性。由於現實世界的倉庫通常超過LLM的輸入長度限制，因此現有方法通常採用檢索增強生成（RAG）來提供特定於倉庫的上下文。儘管改善了倉庫上下文的檢索，但現有方法通常僅將上下文作為任務級支持，而未明確識別在生成過程中需要細粒度倉庫上下文的關鍵標記。在LLM的自回歸生成過程中，錯誤往往集中在少數幾個關鍵位置：一旦這些標記生成錯誤，隨後的代碼可能會遵循錯誤的語義路徑，最終導致功能失敗。我們將這些位置稱為“關鍵標記”。在本文中，我們提出了ACToR，一種自適應關鍵標記感知檢索框架，用於倉庫級別的代碼生成。ACToR在生成過程中識別關鍵標記，並根據需要觸發針對性的檢索，以在這些關鍵位置提供倉庫上下文。此外，我們為密集檢索器設計了一種位置感知加權方法，以優先考慮對生成更具信息量的上下文。我們在兩個具有代表性的倉庫級別基準RepoExec和CoderEval上評估了ACToR。實驗結果顯示，ACToR始終超越最先進的方法，在RepoExec上實現了8.4%的相對提升，在CoderEval上實現了15.4%的相對提升。除了性能提升外，我們系統地量化了關鍵標記的影響，揭示了它們在主要生成失敗中的核心角色，並突顯了針對性檢索策略的必要性。我們在https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR提供了代碼和數據。
